scope: Complete arithmetic/provenance audit of the frozen curated column
precise_description: Returns relative to exchange reference prices, with a raw-close fallback and a 35% unresolved-return screen

formulas.choice: Use reference if reference_price>0 and abs(reference_return)<=.35; otherwise raw. If abs(chosen_return)>.35 or missing, save null.

limits: The internal column name is preserved for byte-identical reproduction. It is not proof of an independently reconciled cash-dividend total-return series. A reference-price adjustment is not generally equal to (close+cash_distribution)/previous_close-1. No event-level adjustment, delisting-proceeds, upstream-download or legal-permission audit is established by this calculation.
